about.what: Curves from the web version of Glass Forms (forms.js, scenes/attractors.js, scenes/knots.js). Written by tools/dump_curves.mjs.
about.maths: Math.sin, cos, exp, log and atan2 were replaced by correctly rounded ones, which is what Chrome has; the rest of Math is this engine's (pow, hypot and round are the same in both).
about.numbers: Exact values are text: 64-bit as the shortest decimal that reads back the same, 32-bit (prep.pts, prep.tail) with nine digits; lists are separated by spaces.
about.raw: pts: every 97th point (x y z); tail: the last 5 points; sum: of all coordinates in order; hash: FNV-1a (32-bit) over the bytes of all of them
about.prep: pts: every 211th point (x y z radius); tail: the last 3 points; sum, hash: as for raw, over pts; brk, brk_hash: the same for the breaks
